title: Watch and Clock Repairers
description: Repair, clean, and adjust mechanisms of timing instruments, such as watches and clocks. Includes watchmakers, watch technicians, and mechanical timepiece repairers.

tasks.text: Clean, rinse, and dry timepiece parts, using solutions and ultrasonic or mechanical watch-cleaning machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Cleaning parts for repair needs hands-on dexterity

dwas.name: Clean equipment, parts, or tools to repair or maintain them in good working order.

tasks.text: Adjust timing regulators, using truing calipers, watch-rate recorders, and tweezers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on equipment adjustment for performance

dwas.name: Adjust equipment to ensure optimal performance.

tasks.text: Reassemble timepieces, replacing glass faces and batteries, before returning them to customers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

tasks.text: Disassemble timepieces and inspect them for defective, worn, misaligned, or rusty parts, using loupes.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Locating wear and damage requires physical inspection

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical equipment to locate damage, defects, or wear.
Disassemble equipment to inspect for deficiencies.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical lubrication task requiring hands and access

dwas.name: Lubricate equipment to allow proper functioning.

tasks.text: Estimate repair costs and timepiece values.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Labor/material cost estimation from rates

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Repair or replace broken, damaged, or worn parts on timepieces, using lathes, drill presses, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual replacement of mechanical parts

dwas.name: Replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Test timepiece accuracy and performance, using meters and other electronic instruments.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Perform regular adjustment and maintenance on timepieces, watch cases, and watch bands.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical maintenance of machinery

tasks.text: Order supplies, including replacement parts, for timing instruments.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

tasks.text: Gather information from customers about a timepiece's problems and its service history.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Assessing customer problems needs live diagnostic dialogue

dwas.name: Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Test and replace batteries and other electronic components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Electrical probing and meter work by hand

dwas.name: Test electrical circuits or components for proper functioning.

tasks.text: Record quantities and types of timepieces repaired, serial and model numbers of items, work performed, and charges for repairs.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of physical workpieces

tasks.text: Fabricate parts for watches and clocks, using small lathes and other machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Part fabrication requires physical machining and handling
